biography.plain_text: Prince Charles de Bourbon des Deux-Siciles is Duke of Castro and heads the Castro branch of the former royal house of the Two Sicilies. Born in southern France and based partly in Monaco, he is also a competitive sailor. He has led the Smeralda 888 class and won multiple class championships on the Mediterranean circuit.

long_biography.plain_text:
Charles de Bourbon des Deux-Siciles succeeded his father as Duke of Castro and head of his branch of the former royal house. His education took him from Toulon and Nice to Paris. Before assuming dynastic leadership, he managed a public-relations firm in New York and held executive posts with Italian businesses.

As Grand Master of the Sacred Military Constantinian Order of Saint George, Charles coordinates charitable, welfare and cultural activities. He changed his branch's succession rules to allow absolute primogeniture, placing his eldest daughter, Maria Carolina, next in line. Through the royal house, he continues to promote the cultural heritage of the former kingdom in southern Italy.
